title: The Collapse of Global Liberalism with Philip Pilkington
description:
Discussion with Philip Pilkington on his book 'The Collapse of Global Liberalism: And the Emergence of the Post Liberal World Order'.

Get Philip Pilkington's 'The Collapse of Global Liberalism' (Polity, 2025) here: https://www.amazon.co.uk/Collapse-Global-Liberalism-Emergence-Liberal/dp/1509566228

Follow Philip on Twitter: https://x.com/philippilk

Follow Philip's 'Multipolarity' podcast: https://www.multi-polarity.com/

Pickthall House is a London-based realist think tank concerned with multipolarity and multiculturalism, with particular focus on the Muslim world.

Follow us on twitter(X): https://x.com/PickthallHouse

Visit our website for articles and white papers on Britain and Muslims in Britain
https://pickthallhouse.org/

#multipolarworld #liberalism #multiculturalism
